Washer (Clothes)

Although we've experienced several service appointments and learned the new AI Scheduling was responsible for date and time for the tech to arrive, AI is NOT advising and scheduling the tech. In other words, the tech had no knowledge that we had an issue. The schedule has been reset 5 times since July 1st and they were NO SHOW on the appointments, the AI system rescheduled, and did not advise the tenant, manager or the service tech.

NOTE TO ADMIN; Please discard the AI system. This caused a lot of stress to everyone involved, life is too short to have this much trouble in asking for simple repairs to be done.

Going forward; Manager, Florencia, became involved and scheduled Jacob Jett (service tech) to arrive early this morning. Jacob did arrive this morning and called me when he was on the way.

Jacob pulled the washer out, examined the hot and cold-water hoses, seems both hoses only have cold water available to the washer.

What I believe has happened, several years ago, there was a water leak found to be in the wall behind the clothes washer. I had a flood in the utility room extending into the kitchen. I won’t go into details of the nightmare we experienced. The only thing that makes sense is both the hot and cold-water hoses were connected to the cold-water source IN THE WALL behind the newly installed sheet rock. It is oblivious, I’ve simply set the washer to use hot water and until recently discovered there is NO hot water to the washer.
In order to correct this error, Jacob stated this would be a contract job, not a simple service call to check hoses.
At this time, I would not want to go through what would be involved in correcting this issue, it’s been this way for some time and I can live with it.

I do have plans to move to a larger home, however until finances and health issues are completed, I will continue to maintain my apartment in excellent condition and this issue can be addressed when I vacate the apartment.

Today, I want to thank Manager Florencia, for getting involved in the AI NO SHOW scheduling issue and a Great Service Tech, Jacob Jett for his help.

Nita (Tenant)
